jenkins-mcp admin

Embedded placeholder UI (UI-008). Full SPA assets were not baked into this binary. Serve a production build with --assets-dir, package path /usr/share/jenkins-mcp/admin-ui, or rebuild with make admin-ui-embed.

API is at /admin/v1/*. Admin HTTP is off until admin serve.

  • /admin/v1/health
  • /admin/v1/version
  • /admin/v1/me
  • /admin/v1/metrics
